info.title: Practice makes fast
info.text: Engineers who design chips recognise common gate patterns instantly. The more sprints you do, the faster you'll spot them too.

info.title: Tip: work backwards
info.text: To write an expression, start at the output gate and work back towards the inputs. Each gate that feeds another becomes a pair of brackets.

info.title: Tip: brackets first
info.text: To build a circuit, find the part in brackets first. That's the gate nearest the inputs.

info.title: Streaks
info.text: Your multiplier goes up by 0.5 for each correct answer in a row, up to ×3. Skipping or a wrong answer resets it, so accuracy matters as much as speed.
